## Rule

**FULLY DECODED + VERIFIED 2026-05-30** (worker-7). ARC uuid `264363fd`. The
generator `external/ARC-GEN/tasks/task_264363fd.py` is the ground truth; the rule
below reproduces it 266/266 visible + 5000/5000 fresh ARC-GEN. The earlier
"multi-rect / cross-template painter" wording (below) was a partial reverse-engineering
of the *graph*, not the rule, and the prompt's "context-recolor / denoise / 10-channel
collapse" framing was simply WRONG (see Don't-do log 2026-05-30).

**True rule — "flags & stars":**
- INPUT = bg canvas + `boxcolor` solid rectangles ("flags", left/stacked) + ONE
  **legend star** (isolated, top-right pre-flip): center `starcolors[0]`, arms
  `starcolors[1]` extending **length 2** in the vert and/or horiz directions, optional
  3×3 surround `starcolors[2]` (may be absent `-1`, or equal `starcolors[0]` when both
  vert&horiz) + single **center pixels** (`starcolors[0]`) marked inside flags.
- OUTPUT = flags preserved; **legend erased to bg**; and for each in-flag marked center:
  a full **line** (arm color) spanning the flag's width (if horiz) / height (if vert),
  then a small **star stamp** (3×3 surround, center, length-1 arms).
- `flip`/`xpose` may rotate the whole scene — so flags can be stacked along EITHER axis,
  which is why both H and V lines need a contiguous-run fill (not a row/col broadcast).

Verified numpy reference: `prototypes/ref_numpy.py`. ONNX-shaped spec (only ONNX ops):
`prototypes/onnx_shaped.py`. Both 266/266 + thousands of fresh ARC-GEN.

<details><summary>Superseded 2026-05-21 partial graph decode</summary>

Partial decode (2026-05-21 radical v4): multi-rect / cross-template painter. The graph first converts one-hot input to a scalar color-index grid (`v29`). It detects non-bg solid 3x3 template cells (`v48b`), derives local arm/diagonal colors by shifted masks + `ReduceMax`, builds side/diagonal stamp masks around detected template cells, extends horizontal/vertical arms with `CumSum` + directional `MaxPool`, then assembles a scalar output color grid and expands back to 10-channel BOOL with `Equal(channel_values, final_color)`.
</details>

## Cost analysis (current — full historical breakdowns in the archive)

**Two architectures, two floors:**
- **100%-truth floor = 26,003** (v7/v8 lineage): color4f F32 3,600 + 8 detection planes (8×900) +
  canvas/scatter chain + 4-direction CumSum run-fill. Byte-equal to the 100% submission.zip parent.
- **Cheap floor = 13,301** (v25 poly-moment lineage, v28): replaces the 8 mask-detection planes with
  per-channel **moment** detection ([1,10] Einsum vectors) + a degree-4 **Vieta root-finder** — no
  full-plane marker masks. But that route is **99.87% truth** (173/200k misses).

**v28/v29 forced planes (`largest_intermediate`, ~13k of 12,950 mem):** `color4f` F32 [30,30]=3,600
(F32 one-hot decode, irreducible) + 4× U8 [30,30] canvas/scatter planes (`color4u`, `scat_h`, `cV`,
`final2d`)=3,600 + `idx2_i64` [41,2] INT64=656 (ScatterND requires INT64) + `idxV` [30,4] INT32=480 +
F16 CumSum strip machinery ~2k. **Structure is walled at ~13,301** (6+ sessions, ±12 B; probe-backed in
`hard_records/striprunscatter_7000_route_dead.md`).

**Correctness lever (2026-07-11):** the 173 misses are NOT irreducible — the DOMINANT cause is a
center-color mis-id (un-normalized `row_varnum = n²·variance` lets the arm color outrank the true
center color). v29 fixes it with one `Div`-by-count (+41 B, cuts misses 8×). The residual ~0.015% is
an inherent degree-4 poly-multiplicity limit; 100%-under-bar needs mask planes (~2-3k > headroom).
Full root cause: `hard_records/centercolor_moment_detector_rootcause.md`.

## Don't-do log

_Record ruled-out hypotheses here so future agents don't retry them. Older entries: see archive._
- **2026-07-11 (cld_worker1): the 173 truth misses are a CENTER-COLOR MIS-ID, not "needs detector logic".**
  The moment-detector picks center color = `argmax(row_varnum)` with `row_varnum = counts*m2 - m1^2 = n²*variance`
  (un-normalized). When both vert&horiz active, the arm color's 8 spread legend cells outrank the few
  clustered marker cells -> wrong center channel -> detection collapses. FIX (v29): `argmax(row_varnum/count)`
  — 40000/40000 vs 39968/40000, miss-set identical to the graph's. One Div + Max-clamp, +41 B, 0 regressions.
  Do NOT re-file the 173 as "detector-debug out of scope" — the dominant part is a 1-Div fix (see hard_records).
- **2026-07-11 (cld_worker1): the residual ~0.015% (post-v29, 2/3/4-marker both-orientation) is an inherent
  poly-multiplicity limit, NOT overflow.** For 2 markers the degree-4 poly `x²(x-a)(x-b)` has a strong double
  root at the marker mean that can crowd a real root out of TopK-4 (dumped seed 770881: col-poly near-zero at
  true 11 & 18 AND at the mean 14-16). Moments are position-normalised & in-range (verified). A cheap 100%-under-bar
  fix would need double-root deflation or exact `legend_same_pows`; UNPROVEN. A reliable fix = mask detection ~2-3k > bar.
- **2026-07-11 (cld_worker1): structure below 13,301 is WALLED.** 5 forced full planes (color4f 3,600 + 4× U8 900
  = 7,200) + INT64/INT32 scatter indices + F16 CumSum core; 6+ sessions ground it to ±12 B. See
  `hard_records/striprunscatter_7000_route_dead.md` (~7000 target proven infeasible) — do not re-explore.
- **2026-07-11 (cld_worker1, 2nd pass): the color source is a probed 4,500 B WALL** (`prototypes/probe_colorsource_floor_2026-07-11.py`).
  Three from-scratch assemblies scored: full Einsum decode→U8 = **4,500** (floor); `box_pix`-only base via
  data-dependent `Gather(input,box_idx,axis=1)` = **5,400** (the gather still pays the full F32 3,600 read + mask+base);
  `ArgMax`→U8 = **8,100** (INT64 trap). No reassembly of the color source beats 4,500. Nibble-pack (#83) is
  inapplicable — the 4 U8 canvas planes are all scattered-into / Equal-compared (compute), not transport.
- **2026-06-24 (w01): CORRECTNESS GAP — v25/v26/v28 are 99.87% truth; the submission.zip parent (26,043) is 100%.**
  task054 is DETERMINISTIC class (§CLASS-CHECK); v25's misses are REAL bugs (not in the 266 officials). v28/v29 are
  byte-equal-vs-LIVE (which is itself <100%), so byte-equal-vs-LIVE is the operative ship gate; v29 is
  strictly more-correct-than-live (§DUAL-TRUTH). The 100%-correct base remains the v7-lineage 26,003.
- **2026-06-24 (w01): the `sp_` small-grid fallback pipeline in v25 is DEAD on all real inputs — removed in v26.**
  `sp_small=(active<899.5)` needs a sub-30x30 grid; the generator hard-codes size=30. Don't rebuild it.
- **2026-05-30 (worker-7): cheap horizontal-line via "box_region ∧ row-has-marker" is WRONG** (69% ARC-GEN).
  After `xpose`, flags share rows so the broadcast leaks. Both H and V lines require the contiguous CumSum run-fill.
- **2026-06-02: `ReduceSum(UINT8)` and `CumSum(UINT8)` are SCORER-REJECTED** (`score_network_v2` returns None).
  Keep F16 CumSum + U8 post-cast; keep `legend_u8 -> ReduceMax`.
- **2026-06-04 (worker-7): plane-count CONSERVATION** — every reformulation of the 8 mask-detection planes lands
